2609.03818.title: CauseCollab: Causal Unified and Modality-Agnostic Network for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
2609.03818.paper_summary: Collaborative perception enhances environment understanding through multi-agent information sharing, but its performance in real-world scenarios is constrained by heterogeneous sensor modalities and model architectures. Recent protocol-based two-stage methods alleviate this problem by mapping heterogeneous features into a shared protocol space; however, independently trained modality-specific converters often generate modality-specific pseudo-protocol distributions, leading to semantic inconsistency and error accumulation, which is particularly pronounced in scenarios with large modality discrepancies. To address this issue, we propose CauseCollab, a causal unified and modality-agnostic network. CauseCollab formulates representation learning in the protocol space from a causal perspective, explicitly disentangling semantic factors from modality-specific statistical confounders via causal metric learning. Meanwhile, CauseCollab adopts context-guided Unified Converter for heterogeneous modalities to ensure cross-modal semantic consistency. In addition, integrating new modalities only requires training adapters with minimal parameters. Extensive experiments on the OPV2V and DAIR-V2X datasets demonstrate that CauseCollab achieves state-of-the-art performance, with more significant gains in scenarios involving large modality gaps.
2609.03818.paper_summary_zh: 協作感知透過多代理資訊共享增強環境理解，但其在現實世界場景中的表現受到異質感測器模態和模型架構的限制。最近基於協議的兩階段方法通過將異質特徵映射到共享協議空間來緩解這個問題；然而，獨立訓練的模態特定轉換器往往生成模態特定的偽協議分佈，導致語義不一致和錯誤累積，這在模態差異較大的場景中特別明顯。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了CauseCollab，一個因果統一且模態無關的網絡。CauseCollab從因果的角度制定了協議空間中的表示學習，通過因果度量學習明確地將語義因素與模態特定的統計混淆因素分離。同時，CauseCollab採用上下文引導的統一轉換器來處理異質模態，以確保跨模態的語義一致性。此外，整合新模態僅需訓練具有最少參數的適配器。在OPV2V和DAIR-V2X數據集上的大量實驗表明，CauseCollab實現了最先進的性能，並在涉及大模態差距的場景中獲得了更顯著的增益。
